titulo: German unemployment tops three million for first time since 2015

fuente.nota: Text shortened by removing paragraphs; the sentences are unchanged.

parrafos: Preliminary data released on Friday by Germany's labour market agency, Bundesagentur für Arbeit (BA), showed that the national unemployment rate reached 6.4% (or 3.025 million people) in August, up 0.1% from last month. This milestone marks the first time since February 2015 that the three-million mark was reached, according to Deutsche Welle.

According to RTÉ, the seasonally adjusted unemployment rate remained at 6.3% (2.96 million), decreasing by 9,000 from July. Compared to the previous August, the number of unemployed increased by 153,000, or 0.3%. BA's broader underemployment figure – encompassing both unemployment and short-term work incapacity – stood at 3.634 million, representing an increase of 25,000 from August 2024. The inflation rate rose to 2.1% in August, exceeding the 2.0% estimated by analysts, according to CNBC.

The labour demand in the primary market has been in decline, with 631,000 job openings reported to the agency in August, 68,000 fewer than the same month last year. The monthly Federal Employment Agency Job Index (BA-X), an indicator of labour market demand according to the Bundesagentur für Arbeit, remained unchanged at 98 points.

In a press statement published on Friday, BA director Andrea Nahles stated that the labour market bore the brunt of consecutive years of economic contraction, but that it is beginning to show tentative signs of stabilisation. She also said the figures reflect the struggles faced by the manufacturing sector. According to a report released by professional services firm EY, the car industry alone lost 110,000 jobs in the last 12 months, France 24 reported. Nahles said she expects the typical seasonal recovery in September to improve the situation but cautioned the number of unemployed could again exceed three million during the winter.
titulo_es: Unemployment in Germany exceeds three million for the first time since 2015
resumen_es: Data from the Federal Employment Agency show that German unemployment exceeded three million people in August, reflecting several years of economic contraction and the crisis in industry, especially the car industry.

ideas_clave.idea: According to provisional figures from the Federal Employment Agency, unemployment in Germany rose to 6.4% in August, passing the symbolic threshold of three million people for the first time since early 2015.

Once seasonal effects are removed, the rate stayed at 6.3% and fell slightly from July, although joblessness was clearly higher than a year earlier, broader underemployment also grew and inflation came in above forecasts.
Demand for labour is weakening, as shown by a marked year-on-year fall in reported vacancies, while the agency's job index stayed flat.

The agency's head blamed several consecutive years of economic contraction and the difficulties of industry, especially car manufacturing, and while she saw tentative signs of stabilisation and expected a seasonal improvement in September, she warned that unemployment could again exceed three million in winter.

resumen_modelo: The article reports that, according to preliminary data from Germany's Federal Employment Agency, the number of jobless people in the country exceeded three million in August, a level not seen since 2015, with the unadjusted rate reaching 6.4%. Nevertheless, the seasonally adjusted rate remained stable at 6.3%, although unemployment was considerably higher than a year before and the broader underemployment measure also increased. At the same time, labour demand is weakening, since employers reported far fewer vacancies than in August 2024, while inflation slightly exceeded analysts' expectations. The head of the agency attributed this deterioration to successive years of economic contraction and to the problems of manufacturing, particularly the car industry, which has shed some 110,000 jobs in a year. Although she detected tentative signs of stabilisation and expected the usual autumn recovery, she cautioned that the three-million mark could be crossed again in winter.

preguntas.enunciado: State whether the statement is true (T), false (F) or not stated (NS).
preguntas.pregunta: The last time German unemployment reached three million was in February 2015.
preguntas.cita: This milestone marks the first time since February 2015 that the three-million mark was reached
preguntas.explicacion: The text says it is the first time since February 2015 that the figure of three million has been reached.

preguntas.pregunta: What was Germany's (unadjusted) unemployment rate in August?
preguntas.cita: the national unemployment rate reached 6.4% (or 3.025 million people) in August
preguntas.explicacion: The unadjusted rate was 6.4%. 6.3% is the seasonally adjusted rate, 2.1% is inflation and 0.3% is the year-on-year increase.

preguntas.enunciado: State whether the statement is true (T), false (F) or not stated (NS).
preguntas.pregunta: The seasonally adjusted number of unemployed people rose by 9,000 compared with July.
preguntas.cita: the seasonally adjusted unemployment rate remained at 6.3% (2.96 million), decreasing by 9,000 from July
preguntas.explicacion: The seasonally adjusted figure fell by 9,000 people compared with July; it did not rise.

preguntas.pregunta: What does the BA's underemployment figure include?
opciones: Only people unemployed for more than a year
preguntas.cita: encompassing both unemployment and short-term work incapacity
preguntas.explicacion: The BA’s underemployment figure includes unemployment and temporary incapacity for work. It does not include vacancies and is not limited to the long-term unemployed.

preguntas.enunciado: State whether the statement is true (T), false (F) or not stated (NS).
preguntas.pregunta: Inflation in August was slightly lower than analysts had expected.
preguntas.cita: The inflation rate rose to 2.1% in August, exceeding the 2.0% estimated by analysts
preguntas.explicacion: Inflation (2.1%) exceeded the analysts’ forecast (2.0%); it was not lower.

preguntas.explicacion: “Seasonally adjusted” applies to data series from which seasonal effects have been removed.

preguntas.cita: with 631,000 job openings reported to the agency in August, 68,000 fewer than the same month last year
preguntas.explicacion: 631,000 vacancies were reported. 68,000 is the year-on-year fall and 98 is the value of the BA-X index, not a number of vacancies.

preguntas.explicacion: The BA-X index remained unchanged at 98 points.

preguntas.explicacion: “To bear the brunt of” means to take the worst of something; here it appears in the past tense (“bore”).

preguntas.explicacion: “Tentative” means provisional or hesitant; it is a false friend of the Spanish “tentativo”/“tentador”.
